warnings: This is a judicial opinion (Cella v. Campbell) analyzing Massachusetts Article 48's prohibition on ballot initiatives "relating to religion." It does not establish rental-housing law itself.
The opinion discusses a proposed rent-control initiative and its religious exemption, but does not finalize the initiative into law or establish its requirements.
No operative rental-housing rules appear in this excerpt; it addresses only constitutional procedure and the validity of a ballot measure under state constitutional doctrine.
